briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 accelerate AGI timelines as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with o4 and Grok-3 pushing capability boundaries. Global compute buildout accelerates while regulatory scrutiny grows in US and EU. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning; xAI deployed Grok-3 on expanded Colossus cluster. Anthropic and Google DeepMind prepare next multimodal releases while Meta open-sources Llama-4 weights. DeepSeek-V3 achieves parity on key benchmarks at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New jailbreak techniques targeting multi-agent systems reported in security blogs. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia ships Blackwell volumes to Microsoft and Google; TSMC ramps 2nm capacity for AI chips. Saudi Arabia announces $50B AI data center initiative with Oracle partnership.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become standard before the first AGI deployment?
